```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/076c8171-9b3b-49b9-a477-244d2a532826.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, header=1)

# Compute rent burden ratio
df_clean['Rent_to_Revenue'] = df_clean['Rent'] / df_clean['Revenue']
# Select vendor(s) with minimum Rent_to_Revenue

least_burden_vendors = df_clean[df_clean['Rent_to_Revenue'] == min_burden]

    print(f"Vendor Name: {row['Name']}")
    print(f"Rent_to_Revenue: {row['Rent_to_Revenue']}")
    print(f"Type: {row['Type']}\n")
```
